ui_bugs.issue: Rapid double-tap on game-get-chances double-adds chances on web. Observed delta +10 after two quick Playwright clicks (expected +5 == CHANCES_PER_AD). The `loadingAd` guard at src/components/games/GameShell.tsx:86 reads from React state captured by closure; because adGate.showAd resolves instantly on web (adsAvailable=false), both click handlers run with stale loadingAd=false from the same render, so the guard never fires. Fix: back the guard with a useRef (e.g. loadingAdRef) set/cleared alongside setLoadingAd, and check the ref at the top of getChances. On production native the AdGate's own non-dismissable Modal masks subsequent taps so the symptom is masked — but the underlying race remains and the request explicitly asked to verify this guard. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/games/GameShell.tsx:84-99.

Spec says welcome amount should render as '₹1.00 added' style but formatRupees(1) renders '₹1 added' (no decimals for whole rupees). Minor/cosmetic. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:267 using formatRupees(1); utils/format formatRupees strips trailing zeros for integer rupee amounts.

action_items: Fix game-get-chances double-tap guard in GameShell.tsx: replace loadingAd (useState) closure check with a useRef (loadingAdRef.current). Set ref=true at the top of getChances and release in finally. Keep setLoadingAd for the Button loading UI. This hardens against instant-resolve ad backends (web/Expo Go) and any rapid tap on native before the Modal mounts.

(Optional cosmetic) If the '₹1.00' style is required, use amount.toFixed(2) for the welcome popup amount text, or change formatRupees to always emit 2 decimals when passed a non-fractional rupee value in this specific place.
critical_code_review_comments: GameShell.tsx:50,86 — loadingAd guard is closure-based React state and does NOT protect against synchronous rapid taps when adGate.showAd resolves instantly. Reproduced on web: 0 → 10 chances after two quick taps. Needs a useRef mirror.

AdGate.tsx — looks correct for native: non-dismissable Modal + settledRef prevents overlapping requests. On web it short-circuits before reserving settledRef, which is fine. Note: settledRef.current starts as true (reserved), reset to false only inside showAd — this is correct for the lifecycle.

rca_of_issue: Game double-chance RCA: On web, src/ads/index.ts exports adsAvailable=false, so src/components/ui/AdGate.tsx showAd() short-circuits with Promise.resolve(true) BEFORE touching settledRef (which is intentional for web UX). Back in GameShell.tsx getChances(), the awaited Promise is already resolved, so React has NOT re-rendered between the first click's `setLoadingAd(true)` and the second click's handler invocation. Each click handler closes over the SAME render's `loadingAd=false`, defeating the guard. Reproduction: open any game → double-click game-get-chances within <100ms → observe chances pill jumps by +10 instead of +5. Mitigation: introduce `const loadingAdRef = useRef(false);` set it `true` synchronously at the start of getChances() and reset in finally, and check `loadingAdRef.current` instead of `loadingAd`.
